Name: Trade Galaxy Weapons
Author: Jibblestein
Description:
Have you ever been using a particular weapon like a dagger or hammer that you enjoy throughout the start of the game, growing to love the playstyle... but then you get given the Galaxy Sword and it's too good to continue using the weapon you love, while it's also too expensive to justify buying a different Galaxy weapon because you have a perfectly good one (that you hate) already? This mod is for you.

This is a simple mod that adds listings to the Adventurer's Guild shop so that you can trade in your Galaxy weapon for a different one rather than having to fork out too much money if you don't like using the sword.

After trading for one of the other weapons, you can trade back to the sword (or any other weapon) risk free!

[b][size=4]How to trade:[/size][/b]
You need to have received the Galaxy Sword first (obviously) before you can trade.

Once unlocked, the trade listings will appear when you open the Adventurer's Guild shop depending on what Galaxy weapons are in your inventory. You will need to close and reopen the shop to refresh the available trades after trading 

The regular options to buy additional weapons are unchanged.

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
Should be compatible with any other mods, unless they completely replace the Adventure Guild Shop's listings.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
Download and extract into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
Delete old files before updating. Config files can be kept to preserve settings.

[b][size=4]Configuration:[/size][/b]
None at the moment, but open to suggestions
